name: Biogas purification, to methane, 99 vol-%, membrane technology process
includedProcesses: Emissions due to leakage and purification of biogas. Input of energy and auxiliary materials. Biogas input excluded from the dataset.
generalComment:
Inventory refers to 1 m3 of methane. Electricity consumption and emissions represent the raw gas compression, H2S removal, gas conditioning and methane enrichment of biogas.  Infrastructure expenditures are included employing generic data for facilities of a chemical plant as approximation.;
